property_summary: The USDV state variable must equal the value of the second argument passed to init; the mutant sets USDV to the VADER argument instead, so calling init(a,b,c) yields different USDV values between P and M for any input where _vader != _usdv.
change_summary: Change `USDV = _usdv;` to `USDV = _vader;` so USDV is set to the VADER address.
